sourceReviewNotes: All 12 paper pages, 20 scheme pages, 61 first-occurrence special-font glyphs, 71 final figures and 102 generated card records visually reviewed.
All 11 Q5 options retained, including both differently themed Q5(j) options; both Q10 alternatives and all four Q12 options retained. No exclusions.

All practical datasets retained. Alternative methods keep their own complete tariff; Q7 cooling remains one choice with matching method explanations. Q11 cards retain the full lighting passage, photographs and 254 nm wavelength.

Q12 maximum and minimum force are separate published 5- and 2-mark tasks. The Sr-90 answer uses the correct 28.78-year half-life values already present among the source alternatives and explains inconsistent printed alternatives.
Original charge-sharing brackets are correct: 3Q² in the numerator. An apparent text-extraction error was resolved by inspecting the original source; no false source-error warning is published.
Opt-in source readers handle equal-font superscripts, nuclear subscripts, duplicate synthetic spacing and compound-path fraction bars. All 30 earlier source generators remain unchanged.
All 102 new IDs reached the runtime deck; no cards dropped. Previously authored cards, runtime blocks, figure entries, review records and unrelated subject files remain unchanged.
